text:
ria: quick flag: the go sample (sdk-go v0.4.2) is printing user ids and emails to stdout during the OAuth refresh path. Redaction only applies for later lines after retry because our otel span gets replaced and the redact hook attaches after logger shim.

ria: repro steps (linux):
```
make examples-go-run
# click 'Request (force-expire)'
```

ria: captured output:
```
2026-04-12T11:11:01Z ERROR call failed user=marc@company.com request_id=req-go-1
2026-04-12T11:11:01Z INFO retrying request attempt=2 request_id=req-go-2
2026-04-12T11:11:01Z ERROR call failed user=[REDACTED] request_id=req-go-2
```

omar: are we sure the logger shim is installed before the redactHook? in go the init order is tricky across packages.

ria: we call instrumentation.InitTelemetry(ctx, opts) from main.main; redactHook is loaded from remote rules client and is async.

miguel: two prongs: (1) make redactHook provide a synchronous fallback ruleset compiled into the binary so early logs are covered, (2) keep a stable request id across retries. right now the retry middleware calls `req.Headers.Set("x-request-id", uuid.NewString())` on each attempt. instead, set once on attempt start and reuse.

tara: also confirm span propagation: some go http clients start a fresh span per retry unless we bind the parent context explicitly. check that `otelhttptrace.NewSpanStartOption` is preserving ctx.

omar: low-risk interim: in sampleapp add a small regex redactor run immediately before any log writes in the auth flow: `re := regexp.MustCompile("[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\\.[a-z]{2,}"); line = re.ReplaceAllString(line, "[REDACTED]")`. not ideal but stops PII in stdout while the hooks load.

miguel: agree. for sdk change we should: 1) on retry middleware, compute attemptId = header.Get("x-rw-attempt") || uuid.New(); set header once; 2) ensure retry uses same trace/span context unless explicitly requested to fork.

ria: i'll open two PRs: one in examples-go (sync fallback rules + quick regex) and one in sdk-go (stable attempt header + test). devtools-bot can you create the issues automatically?

devtools-bot: Generated issues: #2248 (examples-go: early-redact-fallback), #2249 (sdk-go: stable-attempt-id-on-retry). Labels: devex, telemetry, security.

tara: tests: add a go test that runs the expired-token handler, captures stdout, and fails if an email regex matches. also add an integration test to assert that `x-rw-attempt` header is identical across attempts.

omar: note for release: mention this in the changelog under 'telemetry' and call out that customers using custom redaction rules should provide a local fallback to avoid startup windows.

ria: repro env: go 1.21, sdk-go 0.4.2, otel-go 1.14.0. PRs incoming in ~45m.
